claim: Cisco reports $14 million in revenue for Q4 of fiscal 2024
summary: Cisco's reported revenue for Q4 fiscal 2024 was approximately $13.6 billion (~$13.64B), not $14 million. The claimed figure understates actual revenue by a factor of ~1,000 and confuses millions with billions.

sub_claims.text: Cisco reported $14 million in revenue for Q4 of fiscal 2024
sub_claims.stated_text: $14 million in revenue for Q4 of fiscal 2024
sub_claims.note: Without tools, based on model knowledge: Cisco Systems reported Q4 FY2024 (quarter ended July 27, 2024, announced Aug 14, 2024) revenue of ~$13.6-13.7 billion, not $14 million. The claim is off by three orders of magnitude (millions vs billions).
